revisions.reason: Tamoxifen 'has been used for many years to treat breast cancer' and is not standard care for recurrent GBM, so it cannot be soc_backbone; as a fixed-dose approved drug it is a candidate (D31-B13).
With tamoxifen a co-candidate, the experimental arm has two investigational agents, so both are experimental_combination (manual rule 5).
